name: Interrupt — what's on the menu
instructions: Give a quick rundown: drip, americano, or latte for coffee; black, green, or herbal for tea; all come small, medium, or large. Don't list prices unless asked. Keep it to one sentence. Once the patron has heard the menu and either picked a category or moved on, invoke take_exit_path with xp_int_menu_return to hand control back to the caller flow.

entry_condition.expression: Patron asks what's on the menu, what the options are, or what's good.
